title: Aromatic Silky Japanese Peas Inari Zushi
description: A comforting and bitter Japanese dish featuring peas and bonito flakes, served in a sweet and silky inari zushi form, suitable for a low FODMAP diet. This recipe is carefully crafted to provide a soothing and aromatic experience.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese short grain rice thoroughly and cook it with water in a medium saucepan over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low when the water boils, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a small saucepan, combine rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until the sugar and salt dissolve.
Allow the vinegar mixture to cool, then stir it into the cooked rice.
In a separate pan, heat the bonito flakes over low heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Combine the cooked peas and bonito flakes in a bowl and stir to combine.
Cut the aburaage into triangles and cook them in boiling water for 2 minutes to remove excess oil.
Fill the cooked aburaage triangles with the pea and bonito flake mixture, and serve with the Japanese short grain rice.
Garnish with grated daikon and shiso leaves if desired.
